prose: James Frosch of Family Fungi joins InnerVerse to explore the healing power of regenerative living, from mushrooms and medicinal herbs to intuitive gardening and the sacred relationship between soil, spirit, and self.
We talk about the real work of sovereignty, the magic of spent mycelium, and how healing doesn't come in a bottle: it grows from the land beneath your feet.
